variants.prompt: A striking young woman with fiery red curls falling in loose waves, emerald eyes sparkling with mischief under thick lashes, and porcelain skin dusted with a rosy glow, reclines on a plush, velvet chaise in a dimly lit, ornate boudoir. The fitted black sweater and high-waisted distressed denim jeans remain, but the Celtic knot brooch is replaced by a delicate diamond choker. A silver tray bearing a champagne flute and a single, crimson rose rests on the nearby nightstand, evoking an air of indulgence and seduction.
